subject: Physics
prompt: Mirror formula relating u, v, f:
explain: Mirror formula: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f, with sign convention applied.

subject: Physics
prompt: Focal length of concave mirror (radius R):
explain: For a spherical mirror, focal length f = R/2 where R is the radius of curvature.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnification for mirror: m = ?
explain: Linear magnification for mirrors is m = -v/u (negative sign from sign convention).

subject: Physics
prompt: Snell's law at interface of media n₁ and n₂:
explain: Snell's law: n₁sinθ₁ = n₂sinθ₂ at any refracting interface.

subject: Physics
prompt: Critical angle C relates to refractive index as:
explain: At critical angle, refracted ray goes along interface; sinC = n₂/n₁ = 1/n for air-dense interface.

subject: Physics
prompt: TIR occurs when light travels from:
explain: TIR requires light going from denser to rarer medium at angle ≥ critical angle.

subject: Physics
prompt: Lens maker's formula (thin lens, radii R₁, R₂):
explain: Lens maker's formula: 1/f = (n−1)[1/R₁ − 1/R₂], where n is refractive index of lens.

subject: Physics
prompt: Thin lens formula:
explain: For thin lens with sign convention: 1/v − 1/u = 1/f.

subject: Physics
prompt: Power of a lens (unit dioptre):
explain: Power P = 1/f where f must be in metres; unit is dioptre (D).

subject: Physics
prompt: Two thin lenses in contact: combined power?
explain: For lenses in contact, powers add: P = P₁ + P₂ (or 1/f = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂).

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnification for convex lens (image at infinity): m = ?
explain: When image forms at infinity (object at F), magnification is infinite.

subject: Physics
prompt: Angle of deviation in a prism (small angle approximation):
explain: For thin prism with small angle A: δ = (n−1)A.

subject: Physics
prompt: At minimum deviation, the relation between i and r in a prism:
options: i₁ = i₂ and r₁ = r₂ = A/2
explain: At minimum deviation, ray passes symmetrically; i₁=i₂ and r₁=r₂=A/2.

subject: Physics
prompt: Refractive index of prism at minimum deviation δₘ:
explain: Prism formula at minimum deviation: n = sin[(A+δₘ)/2] / sin(A/2).

subject: Physics
prompt: Apparent depth formula (object in denser medium, viewed from rarer):
explain: Apparent depth = real depth/n when viewing from rarer into denser medium.

subject: Physics
prompt: Shift of image due to a glass slab of thickness t, index n:
explain: A slab shifts image towards observer by t(1−1/n); no change in focal length of lens system.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnifying power of simple microscope (image at D = 25 cm):
explain: Simple microscope (magnifier): M = 1 + D/f when image is at near point D = 25 cm.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnifying power of compound microscope (both images at D):
explain: Compound microscope magnification: M = (L/fₒ)×(1+D/fₑ), L = tube length.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnifying power of astronomical telescope (normal adjustment):
explain: Telescope in normal adjustment (image at ∞): M = fₒ/fₑ; large fₒ, small fₑ preferred.

subject: Physics
prompt: Length of telescope tube in normal adjustment:
explain: In normal adjustment, objective and eyepiece are separated by fₒ + fₑ.

subject: Physics
prompt: For a concave mirror, nature of image when object is between F and P:
explain: Object between F and pole of concave mirror → virtual, erect, magnified image behind mirror.

subject: Physics
prompt: A convex mirror always forms image that is:
explain: Convex mirror always gives virtual, erect, diminished image between P and F for any real object.

subject: Physics
prompt: Refraction at spherical surface formula (single surface):
explain: For refraction at single spherical surface: n₂/v − n₁/u = (n₂−n₁)/R.

subject: Physics
prompt: Dispersive power ω of a prism is defined as:
explain: Dispersive power ω = (nᵥ−nᵣ)/(nᵧ−1); measures ability of prism to disperse light.

subject: Physics
prompt: Optical fibre works on principle of:
explain: Optical fibres use TIR repeatedly to transmit light along the fibre with minimal loss.

subject: Physics
prompt: Focal length of convex mirror is always:
explain: Convex mirror has centre of curvature behind mirror, so f = +R/2 (positive).

subject: Physics
prompt: Power of a concave mirror of focal length 20 cm is:
explain: P = –1/f(m) = –1/0.2 = –5 D; concave mirror has negative focal length convention here.

subject: Physics
prompt: Mirror formula sign convention: distances measured from
explain: All distances in mirror formula are measured from the pole along principal axis.

subject: Physics
prompt: For a real object beyond C in concave mirror, image is between:
explain: Object beyond C gives real, inverted, diminished image between F and C.

subject: Physics
prompt: Equivalent focal length of two thin lenses separated by distance d:
explain: For two lenses separated by d, 1/F = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂ – d/(f₁f₂).

subject: Physics
prompt: A glass slab shifts image without changing its:
explain: Glass slab causes only normal shift; image nature (real/virtual) and size remain unchanged.

subject: Physics

explain: At normal incidence i = r = 0, so lateral displacement d = 0; only normal shift occurs.

subject: Physics
prompt: For a convex lens, object at 2F gives image at:
explain: Object at 2F → image at 2F on opposite side; real, inverted, same size (m = –1).

subject: Physics
prompt: A virtual object for a lens is one that:
options: Has converging rays incident on lens
explain: Virtual object: incident rays are converging toward a point behind the lens (u > 0 in new convention).

subject: Physics
prompt: Angle of deviation δ for a ray at a single refracting surface equals:
explain: At a refracting surface the ray bends by δ = i – r (deviation toward normal for denser medium).

subject: Physics
prompt: Minimum deviation condition: refracted ray inside prism is __ to base:
explain: At minimum deviation the ray travels parallel to base; r = A/2 and i₁ = i₂.

subject: Physics
prompt: Angle of prism A relates to refraction angles r₁ and r₂ as:
explain: Geometry of prism gives A = r₁ + r₂ always, regardless of deviation.

subject: Physics
prompt: Total deviation by a prism: δ = i₁ + i₂ – A. At minimum deviation δₘ =
explain: At min deviation i₁ = i₂ = i, so δₘ = 2i – A.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which colour has maximum deviation in a glass prism?
explain: Violet light has highest refractive index in glass, so it deviates most.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which colour travels fastest inside a glass medium?
explain: Red has lowest n in glass → v = c/n is maximum for red.

explain: Tube length L = image distance from objective (v₀) + object distance for eyepiece (uₑ).

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnifying power of simple microscope (image at ∞):
explain: When final image is at infinity (relaxed eye), M = D/f for simple microscope.

subject: Physics
prompt: In a reflecting telescope, the objective is a:
explain: Reflecting telescopes use a large concave mirror as objective to collect and focus light.

subject: Physics
prompt: Resolving power of a telescope depends on aperture D as:
explain: Larger aperture D → smaller θ_min → higher resolving power.

subject: Physics
prompt: For a concave lens, focal length is always:
explain: Concave (diverging) lens always has negative focal length in standard sign convention.

subject: Physics
prompt: A concave lens always forms image that is:
explain: Concave lens is diverging; for any real object it forms virtual, erect, diminished image.

subject: Physics
prompt: If a lens is immersed in liquid with same refractive index as lens, its power is:
explain: Lens maker's formula gives P = 0 when n_lens = n_liquid; lens acts as plain glass.

subject: Physics
prompt: Rainbow formation involves which TWO phenomena?
explain: Raindrops cause dispersion (splitting of white light) and total internal reflection to form rainbow.
